 Carlito believes WWE didn’t initially have faith in Liv Morgan
 By  Shounak Chakrabarti 
 Published: 15 Nov 2026, 08:30

 Liv Morgan heads to the ring for a Queen of the Ring tournament match. (Image credit: WWE) 
 Carlito believes WWE initially lacked confidence in Liv Morgan, but that she eventually convinced the company of her value.
 Recently, speaking on Hitting The Turnbuckle Podcast , Carlito claimed that WWE initially lacked confidence in Morgan. However, she gradually forced WWE to recognize her abilities.
 “I remember too, like when she won the championship the first time, she was like the, what do you call it? The lucky loser kind of thing, right?” 
 “She kind of won and then, and now that, you know, ’cause I feel like the company didn’t believe in her. So, you know, I’m very proud of her that she, you know, she made them believe in her, you know what I mean?” Carlito said.
 “So that’s cool when someone that, you know, you’re not a company person, eventually the company adopts you, you know what I mean? So I’m very proud of her for doing that ’cause I’m sure she wasn’t one of the chosen ones, but she made them choose her.” 
 Morgan signed with WWE in 2014 and soon began on the NXT roster . She later made her WWE main roster debut as part of the Riott Squad. Morgan later found success as a singles wrestler, winning her first women’s championship in 2022. She subsequently teamed with Raquel Rodriguez, with the pair winning the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship in 2023.
